name: asentum-testnet-tool
description: CLI utility for Asentum Testnet interaction

scripts.bet:asebet: node -e "import('./src/wallet.js').then(async w => { const { client, walletsList } = await w.loadAllWallets(); const { executeAseBet } = await import('./src/tasks/asebet.js'); for(const item of walletsList) await executeAseBet(client, item.wallet, 2); })"
scripts.lp:asedex: node -e "import('./src/wallet.js').then(async w => { const { client, walletsList } = await w.loadAllWallets(); const { executeAseDexLiquidity } = await import('./src/tasks/asedexLiquidity.js'); for(const item of walletsList) await executeAseDexLiquidity(client, item.wallet); })"
scripts.dig:treasure: node -e "import('./src/wallet.js').then(async w => { const { client, walletsList } = await w.loadAllWallets(); const { executeTreasureDig } = await import('./src/tasks/treasureHunt.js'); for(const item of walletsList) await executeTreasureDig(client, item.wallet); })"
